requirements.title: Only eligible students may apply for the scholarship.
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Only eligible students may apply for the scholarship.

requirements.title: A student must be enrolled in a full-time
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: A student must be enrolled in a full-time undergraduate programme at the institute.

requirements.title: The student must have a cumulative grade point
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: The student must have a cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of at least 8.0 in the previous academic year.

requirements.title: The annual family income of the student must
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: The annual family income of the student must not exceed 5,00,000 rupees.

requirements.title: Students who have already received another scholarship from
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Students who have already received another scholarship from the institute in the same academic year cannot apply.

requirements.title: Applications must be submitted before 31 March of
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Applications must be submitted before 31 March of each year.

requirements.title: Applications received after this date will not be
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Applications received after this date will not be accepted.

requirements.title: The online application portal opens on 1 February.
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: The online application portal opens on 1 February.

requirements.title: The last date to submit the scholarship application
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: The last date to submit the scholarship application is 15 April.

requirements.title: Students are informed about the result through the
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Students are informed about the result through the portal.

requirements.title: Students who are not selected are not sent
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Students who are not selected are not sent any separate message.

requirements.title: Questions about the scholarship should be sent to
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce: Questions about the scholarship should be sent to the Scholarship Office of the institute.

requirements.title: Fill online application form
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Fill online application form performed by student

requirements.title: Upload required documents
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Upload required documents performed by student

requirements.title: Check form and documents
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Check form and documents performed by scholarship clerk

requirements.title: Return incomplete applications
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Return incomplete applications

requirements.title: Verify form
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Verify form

requirements.title: Check documents for genuineness
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Check documents for genuineness performed by scholarship clerk

requirements.title: Review application and recommend
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Review application and recommend performed by Head of Department (HOD)

requirements.title: Review applications and select awardees
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Review applications and select awardees performed by Scholarship Committee

requirements.title: Transfer scholarship amount
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Transfer scholarship amount performed by Accounts Office

requirements.title: Receive scholarship amount
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Receive scholarship amount performed by Each selected student

requirements.title: Pay amount in single instalment
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Pay amount in single instalment

requirements.title: Meet and display awardees list
requirements.statement: The process shall include the step: Meet and display awardees list performed by Scholarship Committee
